{"name":"assets/857945325297514676","designSystem":{"displayName":"Bodylines Studio","theme":{"colorMode":"LIGHT","roundness":"ROUND_TWO","customColor":"#D8431B","bodyFont":"HANKEN_GROTESK","labelFont":"HANKEN_GROTESK","designMd":"# Design System: Bodylines

## 1. Visual Theme & Atmosphere
A car-design studio at daylight. One sculpted car body sits on a pale, fog-grey studio floor
under soft top light, and it physically reshapes itself as the visitor scrolls from 1886 to
today. Everything around it is quiet: expanded badge-like type, generous air, one signal
colour. Density 3 (gallery airy), variance 7 (offset asymmetric), motion 8 (scroll choreography
driven by the visitor, never autoplaying loops).

## 2. Color Palette & Roles
- **Studio Fog** (#DCDFE2) - page background, the studio cyclorama
- **Clay Light** (#EEF0F1) - top of the studio light falloff, raised surfaces
- **Graphite Ink** (#15181C) - headlines and body text
- **Steel** (#50565E) - secondary text, spec labels
- **Year Ghost** (#CDD1D5) - the giant background year, decorative only
- **Signal Orange** (#D8431B) - the only accent: timeline progress, active era, focus rings
No purple, no neon, no gradients on text, no pure black.

## 3. Typography Rules
- **Display:** Anybody, width 150 (expanded), weight 800, tight tracking (-0.02em). Reads like
  a chrome boot badge. Used for the site title, era car names and the giant year.
- **Body:** Hanken Grotesk 400/500, 1.6 leading, 60ch max.
- **Numbers in spec rows:** Anybody width 110, tabular figures.
- Sentence case everywhere. No all-caps labels, no eyebrows above every heading.

## 4. Component Stylings
- **Chapter panel:** no card. Text sits directly on the fog, left column, separated from the
  next chapter by space only.
- **Spec row:** three label/value pairs in a row, value large, label small in Steel above it.
- **Timeline rail:** thin vertical line on the right edge, seven era years, the current one in
  Signal Orange with a filled progress line. Clicking a year scrolls to that era.
- **Buttons/links:** text links with a 1px underline that thickens on hover. Square corners.
- Radius: 0 everywhere except the 3D render itself.

## 5. Layout Principles
Fixed full-viewport 3D stage behind the scrolling text. Text column on the left third, the car
occupies the centre-right. The giant year sits behind the car, anchored to the bottom edge.
Below 768px: the car takes the top 55% of the screen, text panels scroll over the lower part
on a fog-tinted backing. Max content width 1400px. Full-height sections use 100dvh.

## 6. Motion & Interaction
Scroll is the only clock. Scroll position morphs the car body, rolls the wheels, orbits the
camera and counts the year. Lenis smooths the scroll. Chapter text fades in once per chapter.
Transform and opacity only. Under prefers-reduced-motion: no smoothing, no camera orbit, the
car still changes shape per chapter (it is content, not decoration).

## 7. Anti-Patterns (Banned)
No emojis. No Inter. No em dashes in copy. No invented statistics: every spec is a published
figure. No scroll cues. No 3 equal cards. No section numbering eyebrows. No neon glows.
